detail.from:
Historical c3746 guards and the B-1064 through B-1085 architecture are source-connected: exact typed player identity, candidate-first roster/stage/manifest preparation, authenticated protocol-v55 client settings, immutable network launch consumption, engine-forced option ownership, explicit stage-reuse defaults, PC-native delayed-save ownership, Room rematch adoption, generated-character floor/root relocation, exact generated-GDL traversal bounds, and finite fixture-owned diagnostics.

The accepted current runtime baseline passes a bounded 13/13 generated-audit diagnostic, a diagnostics-disabled 56/56 two-cycle ordinary Combat Simulator fixture, and the source-frozen 145/145 initiator-authority friend-play fixture. Together they prove stable generated-character placement, natural hit traversal, awards/stats persistence, native save, real Play Again return, setup preservation, two complete endscreens, exactly one authority-first listen startup plus typed signed route plus idempotent join, Needler gameplay/presentation witnesses, and clean exits. The prior full pd-tests suite passed 59,094 assertions in 1,117 cases and the public native-source guard passed.

B-1084 is a regression gate. The source-frozen invitee-authority receipt passes D-003 election, one in-client ENet listen bind, separately typed signed-route publication, one idempotent join, package transfer, manifest readiness, two-player immutable stage start, cutscene exit, and Needler model load. It remains rejected at 138/144 solely because B-1085 prevents the background authority from consuming smoke-owned injected gameplay input: injection mutates ActionState, but public reads still apply the production focus suppression gate. Current source implements explicit held/release ownership and a player-aware read gate that bypasses only focus-loss/regain settling under Gameplay or Forge; physical dispatch, analog polling, typed layers, menus, freefly, flush, and release-edge cleanup remain authoritative. The first ownership revision passed build, focused 59/5, D-003 119/5, full 59,149/1,118, and the native-source guard on `5cd19966...`, but Luna xhigh review found physical axis overwrite and coincident physical-edge ownership gaps before runtime; that binary is superseded. Current source routes all physical axis writes/zeroing through an ownership-aware setter, makes fireVk defer before mutation for the exact owned action, and strengthens function-scoped contracts. The corrected `8be06c29...` unit passes build, B-1085/input-layer 111/5, D-003 119/5, full 59,201/1,118, and the native-source guard; exact client `DB92FB2F...`, tests `1017E05A...`, updater `C7446779...`. Both-role runtime verification remains pending.

T-ENGINE-004 remains partial. Closure still requires B-1085 focused/full verification and both current-source authority reruns, ordinary Campaign/player-init, all-17-mission/restart regression, stage-transition reset, strengthened listen-host/client lifecycle, disconnect/reconnect, D-003 failure rollback, and a gameplay capture retaining V-009 visual gates. Receipts with source overlap, stale binaries, early termination, diagnostic-only behavior, or missing assertions remain rejected.

The first corrected invitee rerun passed all 144 existing assertions, but it remains partial rather than B-1085 closure because those assertions could succeed without proving focus loss, smoke ownership, and the gameplay read path; the run also omitted retained raw logs. The invitee-process fixture now requires all three witnesses. A retained-log invitee rerun and then initiator-authority rerun on the same source freeze remain pending.

The retained strengthened invitee run proves the owned fire and gameplay read path but is rejected at 146/147 because process launch did not produce a deterministic focus transition. The verifier must focus the declared source process, then the target process, and wait fail-closed for the source log witness before the smoke can exercise B-1085 intentionally.

The generic deterministic focus verifier is source-connected and passes focused, D-003, full-suite, native-source, AST, JSON, and C# interop compilation gates on candidate freeze `4257975d...`. The invitee and initiator ordinary-client reruns remain pending; candidate evidence is not runtime acceptance.
The first deterministic-focus attempt is rejected at 62/147: focus orchestration began only after the invitee readiness barrier, while the first-launch initiator was still extracting and had no SDL window. The fixture now requires both named readiness markers. Luna's second xhigh review then found that unordered presence checks could still combine a focus loss with an earlier fire pulse. Current source adds a generic strict ordered-sequence assertion family, append-only log freshness, target-foreground revalidation, full timeout-bound focus acquisition, an exact clean owner-acquisition witness, and a production-linked pure action-read authority seam with native unowned focus-loss denial. Smoke release can no longer seize or mutate unowned physical state. These changes pass PowerShell AST, fixture JSON, C# interop compilation, and assertion-engine behavioral self-tests; compiled and ordinary-client evidence remain pending.
The causal-authority revision now compiles in both shipping client and pd-tests. On an unchanged 6bd8d3ec.../3104-file source fingerprint, focused B-1085/action authority passes 316/28, canonical D-003 passes 167/6, the full suite passes 59,297/1,124, the ordered assertion self-test passes, and the native-source guard passes. Exact candidate hashes are client 77E869A6..., tests 07BC22CB..., updater C7446779.... Luna follow-up and both retained ordinary-client authority roles remain pending, so this is compiled partial evidence rather than B-1085 closure.

The next invitee-authority attempt was rejected before any client launched because a stale typed catalog ID had been placed in remove_paths and could not be resolved as a Windows filesystem path. B-1087 removes that entry from every affected fixture and adds repository-wide path lint. Luna then found an exact-deadline fail-open race in the new readiness harness; current B-1085 source gives pending taps and wait/overall deadlines priority over success or scripted exit, invalidates readiness on stage teardown, and requires strict wait-budget headroom. Both authority fixtures now reserve 60 seconds beyond their 300-second worst-case schedule. This revision is unbuilt, so T-ENGINE-004 remains partial.

The first consolidated both-role runtime batch was stopped after the initiator-authority case exposed B-1088. Route authority, listen startup, typed signed route consumption, one join, package readiness, and two-player stage start all occurred, but presentation timing legitimately diverged: one peer had already reached gameplay while the fixture still demanded the cutscene-only aperture. That wait timed out and disconnected the other peer. No result JSON is accepted. Current source replaces the rigid branch with a pure skip-or-gameplay transition and gates the Skip press on the exact cutscene predicate; release remains unconditional. This revision is structurally checked but unbuilt, so status remains partial.
The one-shot B-1088 candidate subsequently passed its consolidated build, focused, full, assertion-engine, and native-source gates on unchanged source `0AD48E4D...`, but ordinary-client runtime rejected the design. Both peers briefly reported gameplay-ready and therefore skipped no input; the authored intro then took control, causing the final gameplay barriers to fail and one peer to disconnect. No result JSON is accepted, and the second authority role was deliberately aborted. Current work is replacing that transient predicate with a reusable stateful barrier that requires continuously stable gameplay, may inject exactly one bounded production Skip only when the real cutscene aperture appears, always releases ownership, and keeps timeout precedence. T-ENGINE-004 remains partial pending a new source freeze and both retained authority-role smokes.

The first stateful-barrier client build is superseded before test/runtime acceptance. Luna xhigh found four adjacent fail-closed gaps in the smoke infrastructure: no explicit stable-duration receipt, unbounded explicit holds across paused waits, ignored known fields on incompatible event types, and permissive truncated JSON. Sol is integrating these as one structural schema/ownership/evidence correction, after which client and tests will be rebuilt once and verified as one source-frozen unit.

The corrected stateful/schema unit now builds both the shipping client and pd-tests on unchanged source 9249cfa6.... Focused B-1088/B-1085/D-003 coverage passes 536/28, the full suite passes 60,374/1,141, ordered assertion self-tests pass, and the native-source guard passes. Exact client is 36F443BC.... Both retained authority-role ordinary-client smokes remain the only B-1088/D-003 acceptance gate for this freeze.
B-1089 source is now connected but remains unverified. Protocol v56 adds exact request/state/result codecs, authenticated source validation, stage-scoped generation, stable client-ID to receiver-local runtime-slot mapping, an idempotent bounded server acceptance queue, reliable end-of-frame publication, and reset-time retirement. Both ordinary-client authority fixtures require authority acceptance/publication and non-authority application before their stable gameplay receipts. Status remains partial until one replacement source freeze passes the consolidated build/test/guard batch and both retained authority-role smokes.

B-1089 now has accepted source-frozen automated evidence. The protocol-v56 unit compiles in the shipping client and pd-tests; focused coverage passes 651/34, full automation passes 60,470/1,146, assertion and native-source guards pass, and source 6c9d65fd... remained unchanged. T-ENGINE-004 stays partial because both retained ordinary-client authority-role smokes still must prove authority acceptance/publication, non-authority application, continuous gameplay readiness, D-003 route invariants, and clean process exit.

The first protocol-v56 runtime role is accepted: initiator-authority passed 184/184 with one authority acceptance/publication, one non-authority application, both stable gameplay windows, ordered focus ownership/fire/effects, clean exits, and zero leaked processes. The inverse role rejected at 122/188 before its cutscene assertions because sequential launch readiness let focus orchestration begin while the elected invitee authority was still blocked in its bounded public-route probe. This is an orchestration phase race, not a production protocol failure. The fixture now reuses the generic second-process gameplay_ready launch barrier before changing focus; that correction remains source-only pending one consolidated automation batch and one invitee-authority rerun on unchanged client D2F9A886....

The retained inverse rerun exposed a production authority-token defect after the focus phase barrier itself held correctly. The remote initiator sent generation 3 while the elected invitee authority owned generation 2 because playerStartCutscene2 incremented independently on every peer and SVC_CUTSCENE state remained co-op/anti-only. Sol is replacing peer-local reproduction with authority ownership: server/offline alone mints, every network game mode receives stable-client-mask start/end state, and clients synchronize without incrementing. Status remains partial until one consolidated source-frozen batch and the inverse-role ordinary-client receipt pass.

detail.from:
Historical c3746 guards and the B-1064 through B-1085 architecture are source-connected: exact typed player identity, candidate-first roster/stage/manifest preparation, authenticated protocol-v55 client settings, immutable network launch consumption, engine-forced option ownership, explicit stage-reuse defaults, PC-native delayed-save ownership, Room rematch adoption, generated-character floor/root relocation, exact generated-GDL traversal bounds, and finite fixture-owned diagnostics.

The accepted current runtime baseline passes a bounded 13/13 generated-audit diagnostic, a diagnostics-disabled 56/56 two-cycle ordinary Combat Simulator fixture, and the source-frozen 145/145 initiator-authority friend-play fixture. Together they prove stable generated-character placement, natural hit traversal, awards/stats persistence, native save, real Play Again return, setup preservation, two complete endscreens, exactly one authority-first listen startup plus typed signed route plus idempotent join, Needler gameplay/presentation witnesses, and clean exits. The prior full pd-tests suite passed 59,094 assertions in 1,117 cases and the public native-source guard passed.

B-1084 is a regression gate. The source-frozen invitee-authority receipt passes D-003 election, one in-client ENet listen bind, separately typed signed-route publication, one idempotent join, package transfer, manifest readiness, two-player immutable stage start, cutscene exit, and Needler model load. It remains rejected at 138/144 solely because B-1085 prevents the background authority from consuming smoke-owned injected gameplay input: injection mutates ActionState, but public reads still apply the production focus suppression gate. Current source implements explicit held/release ownership and a player-aware read gate that bypasses only focus-loss/regain settling under Gameplay or Forge; physical dispatch, analog polling, typed layers, menus, freefly, flush, and release-edge cleanup remain authoritative. The first ownership revision passed build, focused 59/5, D-003 119/5, full 59,149/1,118, and the native-source guard on `5cd19966...`, but Luna xhigh review found physical axis overwrite and coincident physical-edge ownership gaps before runtime; that binary is superseded. Current source routes all physical axis writes/zeroing through an ownership-aware setter, makes fireVk defer before mutation for the exact owned action, and strengthens function-scoped contracts. The corrected `8be06c29...` unit passes build, B-1085/input-layer 111/5, D-003 119/5, full 59,201/1,118, and the native-source guard; exact client `DB92FB2F...`, tests `1017E05A...`, updater `C7446779...`. Both-role runtime verification remains pending.

T-ENGINE-004 remains partial. Closure still requires B-1085 focused/full verification and both current-source authority reruns, ordinary Campaign/player-init, all-17-mission/restart regression, stage-transition reset, strengthened listen-host/client lifecycle, disconnect/reconnect, D-003 failure rollback, and a gameplay capture retaining V-009 visual gates. Receipts with source overlap, stale binaries, early termination, diagnostic-only behavior, or missing assertions remain rejected.

The first corrected invitee rerun passed all 144 existing assertions, but it remains partial rather than B-1085 closure because those assertions could succeed without proving focus loss, smoke ownership, and the gameplay read path; the run also omitted retained raw logs. The invitee-process fixture now requires all three witnesses. A retained-log invitee rerun and then initiator-authority rerun on the same source freeze remain pending.

The retained strengthened invitee run proves the owned fire and gameplay read path but is rejected at 146/147 because process launch did not produce a deterministic focus transition. The verifier must focus the declared source process, then the target process, and wait fail-closed for the source log witness before the smoke can exercise B-1085 intentionally.

The generic deterministic focus verifier is source-connected and passes focused, D-003, full-suite, native-source, AST, JSON, and C# interop compilation gates on candidate freeze `4257975d...`. The invitee and initiator ordinary-client reruns remain pending; candidate evidence is not runtime acceptance.
The first deterministic-focus attempt is rejected at 62/147: focus orchestration began only after the invitee readiness barrier, while the first-launch initiator was still extracting and had no SDL window. The fixture now requires both named readiness markers. Luna's second xhigh review then found that unordered presence checks could still combine a focus loss with an earlier fire pulse. Current source adds a generic strict ordered-sequence assertion family, append-only log freshness, target-foreground revalidation, full timeout-bound focus acquisition, an exact clean owner-acquisition witness, and a production-linked pure action-read authority seam with native unowned focus-loss denial. Smoke release can no longer seize or mutate unowned physical state. These changes pass PowerShell AST, fixture JSON, C# interop compilation, and assertion-engine behavioral self-tests; compiled and ordinary-client evidence remain pending.
The causal-authority revision now compiles in both shipping client and pd-tests. On an unchanged 6bd8d3ec.../3104-file source fingerprint, focused B-1085/action authority passes 316/28, canonical D-003 passes 167/6, the full suite passes 59,297/1,124, the ordered assertion self-test passes, and the native-source guard passes. Exact candidate hashes are client 77E869A6..., tests 07BC22CB..., updater C7446779.... Luna follow-up and both retained ordinary-client authority roles remain pending, so this is compiled partial evidence rather than B-1085 closure.

The next invitee-authority attempt was rejected before any client launched because a stale typed catalog ID had been placed in remove_paths and could not be resolved as a Windows filesystem path. B-1087 removes that entry from every affected fixture and adds repository-wide path lint. Luna then found an exact-deadline fail-open race in the new readiness harness; current B-1085 source gives pending taps and wait/overall deadlines priority over success or scripted exit, invalidates readiness on stage teardown, and requires strict wait-budget headroom. Both authority fixtures now reserve 60 seconds beyond their 300-second worst-case schedule. This revision is unbuilt, so T-ENGINE-004 remains partial.

The first consolidated both-role runtime batch was stopped after the initiator-authority case exposed B-1088. Route authority, listen startup, typed signed route consumption, one join, package readiness, and two-player stage start all occurred, but presentation timing legitimately diverged: one peer had already reached gameplay while the fixture still demanded the cutscene-only aperture. That wait timed out and disconnected the other peer. No result JSON is accepted. Current source replaces the rigid branch with a pure skip-or-gameplay transition and gates the Skip press on the exact cutscene predicate; release remains unconditional. This revision is structurally checked but unbuilt, so status remains partial.
The one-shot B-1088 candidate subsequently passed its consolidated build, focused, full, assertion-engine, and native-source gates on unchanged source `0AD48E4D...`, but ordinary-client runtime rejected the design. Both peers briefly reported gameplay-ready and therefore skipped no input; the authored intro then took control, causing the final gameplay barriers to fail and one peer to disconnect. No result JSON is accepted, and the second authority role was deliberately aborted. The accepted current runtime baseline passes a bounded 13/13 generated-audit diagnostic, a diagnostics-disabled 56/56 two-cycle ordinary Combat Simulator fixture, and the source-frozen 145/145 initiator-authority friend-play fixture. Together they prove stable generated-character placement, natural hit traversal, awards/stats persistence, native save, real Play Again return, setup preservation, two complete endscreens, exactly one authority-first listen startup plus typed signed route plus idempotent join, Needler gameplay/presentation witnesses, and clean exits. Current source implements explicit held/release ownership and a player-aware read gate that bypasses only focus-loss/regain settling under Gameplay or Forge; physical dispatch, analog polling, typed layers, menus, freefly, flush, and release-edge cleanup remain authoritative. The first ownership revision passed build, focused 59/5, D-003 119/5, full 59,149/1,118, and the native-source guard on `5cd19966...`, but Luna xhigh review found physical axis overwrite and coincident physical-edge ownership gaps before runtime; that binary is superseded. Historical c3746 guards and the B-1064 through B-1085 architecture are source-connected: exact typed player identity, candidate-first roster/stage/manifest preparation, authenticated protocol-v55 client settings, immutable network launch consumption, engine-forced option ownership, explicit stage-reuse defaults, PC-native delayed-save ownership, Room rematch adoption, generated-character floor/root relocation, exact generated-GDL traversal bounds, and finite fixture-owned diagnostics.

The accepted current runtime baseline passes a bounded 13/13 generated-audit diagnostic, a diagnostics-disabled 56/56 two-cycle ordinary Combat Simulator fixture, and the source-frozen 145/145 initiator-authority friend-play fixture. Together they prove stable generated-character placement, natural hit traversal, awards/stats persistence, native save, real Play Again return, setup preservation, two complete endscreens, exactly one authority-first listen startup plus typed signed route plus idempotent join, Needler gameplay/presentation witnesses, and clean exits. The prior full pd-tests suite passed 59,094 assertions in 1,117 cases and the public native-source guard passed.

B-1084 is a regression gate. The source-frozen invitee-authority receipt passes D-003 election, one in-client ENet listen bind, separately typed signed-route publication, one idempotent join, package transfer, manifest readiness, two-player immutable stage start, cutscene exit, and Needler model load. It remains rejected at 138/144 solely because B-1085 prevents the background authority from consuming smoke-owned injected gameplay input: injection mutates ActionState, but public reads still apply the production focus suppression gate. Current source implements explicit held/release ownership and a player-aware read gate that bypasses only focus-loss/regain settling under Gameplay or Forge; physical dispatch, analog polling, typed layers, menus, freefly, flush, and release-edge cleanup remain authoritative. The first ownership revision passed build, focused 59/5, D-003 119/5, full 59,149/1,118, and the native-source guard on `5cd19966...`, but Luna xhigh review found physical axis overwrite and coincident physical-edge ownership gaps before runtime; that binary is superseded. Current source routes all physical axis writes/zeroing through an ownership-aware setter, makes fireVk defer before mutation for the exact owned action, and strengthens function-scoped contracts. The corrected `8be06c29...` unit passes build, B-1085/input-layer 111/5, D-003 119/5, full 59,201/1,118, and the native-source guard; exact client `DB92FB2F...`, tests `1017E05A...`, updater `C7446779...`. Both-role runtime verification remains pending.

T-ENGINE-004 remains partial. Closure still requires B-1085 focused/full verification and both current-source authority reruns, ordinary Campaign/player-init, all-17-mission/restart regression, stage-transition reset, strengthened listen-host/client lifecycle, disconnect/reconnect, D-003 failure rollback, and a gameplay capture retaining V-009 visual gates. Receipts with source overlap, stale binaries, early termination, diagnostic-only behavior, or missing assertions remain rejected.

The first corrected invitee rerun passed all 144 existing assertions, but it remains partial rather than B-1085 closure because those assertions could succeed without proving focus loss, smoke ownership, and the gameplay read path; the run also omitted retained raw logs. The invitee-process fixture now requires all three witnesses. A retained-log invitee rerun and then initiator-authority rerun on the same source freeze remain pending.

The retained strengthened invitee run proves the owned fire and gameplay read path but is rejected at 146/147 because process launch did not produce a deterministic focus transition. The verifier must focus the declared source process, then the target process, and wait fail-closed for the source log witness before the smoke can exercise B-1085 intentionally.

The generic deterministic focus verifier is source-connected and passes focused, D-003, full-suite, native-source, AST, JSON, and C# interop compilation gates on candidate freeze `4257975d...`. The invitee and initiator ordinary-client reruns remain pending; candidate evidence is not runtime acceptance.
The first deterministic-focus attempt is rejected at 62/147: focus orchestration began only after the invitee readiness barrier, while the first-launch initiator was still extracting and had no SDL window. The fixture now requires both named readiness markers. Luna's second xhigh review then found that unordered presence checks could still combine a focus loss with an earlier fire pulse. Current source adds a generic strict ordered-sequence assertion family, append-only log freshness, target-foreground revalidation, full timeout-bound focus acquisition, an exact clean owner-acquisition witness, and a production-linked pure action-read authority seam with native unowned focus-loss denial. Smoke release can no longer seize or mutate unowned physical state. These changes pass PowerShell AST, fixture JSON, C# interop compilation, and assertion-engine behavioral self-tests; compiled and ordinary-client evidence remain pending.
The causal-authority revision now compiles in both shipping client and pd-tests. On an unchanged 6bd8d3ec.../3104-file source fingerprint, focused B-1085/action authority passes 316/28, canonical D-003 passes 167/6, the full suite passes 59,297/1,124, the ordered assertion self-test passes, and the native-source guard passes. Exact candidate hashes are client 77E869A6..., tests 07BC22CB..., updater C7446779.... Luna follow-up and both retained ordinary-client authority roles remain pending, so this is compiled partial evidence rather than B-1085 closure.

The next invitee-authority attempt was rejected before any client launched because a stale typed catalog ID had been placed in remove_paths and could not be resolved as a Windows filesystem path. B-1087 removes that entry from every affected fixture and adds repository-wide path lint. Luna then found an exact-deadline fail-open race in the new readiness harness; current B-1085 source gives pending taps and wait/overall deadlines priority over success or scripted exit, invalidates readiness on stage teardown, and requires strict wait-budget headroom. Both authority fixtures now reserve 60 seconds beyond their 300-second worst-case schedule. This revision is unbuilt, so T-ENGINE-004 remains partial.

The first consolidated both-role runtime batch was stopped after the initiator-authority case exposed B-1088. Route authority, listen startup, typed signed route consumption, one join, package readiness, and two-player stage start all occurred, but presentation timing legitimately diverged: one peer had already reached gameplay while the fixture still demanded the cutscene-only aperture. That wait timed out and disconnected the other peer. No result JSON is accepted. Current source replaces the rigid branch with a pure skip-or-gameplay transition and gates the Skip press on the exact cutscene predicate; release remains unconditional. This revision is structurally checked but unbuilt, so status remains partial.
The one-shot B-1088 candidate subsequently passed its consolidated build, focused, full, assertion-engine, and native-source gates on unchanged source `0AD48E4D...`, but ordinary-client runtime rejected the design. Both peers briefly reported gameplay-ready and therefore skipped no input; the authored intro then took control, causing the final gameplay barriers to fail and one peer to disconnect. No result JSON is accepted, and the second authority role was deliberately aborted. Current work is replacing that transient predicate with a reusable stateful barrier that requires continuously stable gameplay, may inject exactly one bounded production Skip only when the real cutscene aperture appears, always releases ownership, and keeps timeout precedence. T-ENGINE-004 remains partial pending a new source freeze and both retained authority-role smokes.

The first stateful-barrier client build is superseded before test/runtime acceptance. Luna xhigh found four adjacent fail-closed gaps in the smoke infrastructure: no explicit stable-duration receipt, unbounded explicit holds across paused waits, ignored known fields on incompatible event types, and permissive truncated JSON. Sol is integrating these as one structural schema/ownership/evidence correction, after which client and tests will be rebuilt once and verified as one source-frozen unit.

The corrected stateful/schema unit now builds both the shipping client and pd-tests on unchanged source 9249cfa6.... Focused B-1088/B-1085/D-003 coverage passes 536/28, the full suite passes 60,374/1,141, ordered assertion self-tests pass, and the native-source guard passes. Exact client is 36F443BC.... Both retained authority-role ordinary-client smokes remain the only B-1088/D-003 acceptance gate for this freeze.
B-1089 source is now connected but remains unverified. Protocol v56 adds exact request/state/result codecs, authenticated source validation, stage-scoped generation, stable client-ID to receiver-local runtime-slot mapping, an idempotent bounded server acceptance queue, reliable end-of-frame publication, and reset-time retirement. Both ordinary-client authority fixtures require authority acceptance/publication and non-authority application before their stable gameplay receipts. Status remains partial until one replacement source freeze passes the consolidated build/test/guard batch and both retained authority-role smokes.

B-1089 now has accepted source-frozen automated evidence. The protocol-v56 unit compiles in the shipping client and pd-tests; focused coverage passes 651/34, full automation passes 60,470/1,146, assertion and native-source guards pass, and source 6c9d65fd... remained unchanged. T-ENGINE-004 stays partial because both retained ordinary-client authority-role smokes still must prove authority acceptance/publication, non-authority application, continuous gameplay readiness, D-003 route invariants, and clean process exit.

The first protocol-v56 runtime role is accepted: initiator-authority passed 184/184 with one authority acceptance/publication, one non-authority application, both stable gameplay windows, ordered focus ownership/fire/effects, clean exits, and zero leaked processes. The inverse role rejected at 122/188 before its cutscene assertions because sequential launch readiness let focus orchestration begin while the elected invitee authority was still blocked in its bounded public-route probe. This is an orchestration phase race, not a production protocol failure. The fixture now reuses the generic second-process gameplay_ready launch barrier before changing focus; that correction remains source-only pending one consolidated automation batch and one invitee-authority rerun on unchanged client D2F9A886....

The retained inverse rerun exposed a production authority-token defect after the focus phase barrier itself held correctly. The remote initiator sent generation 3 while the elected invitee authority owned generation 2 because playerStartCutscene2 incremented independently on every peer and SVC_CUTSCENE state remained co-op/anti-only. Sol is replacing peer-local reproduction with authority ownership: server/offline alone mints, every network game mode receives stable-client-mask start/end state, and clients synchronize without incrementing. Status remains partial until one consolidated source-frozen batch and the inverse-role ordinary-client receipt pass.

Current B-1089 source now implements the broader transactional correction identified by the inverse-role failure and Luna xhigh audit: the validated stage roster is frozen per match; one room-scoped reliable queue preserves START -> ACCEPT -> END; START/END queue preflight precedes local mutation; failed sends retain idempotent retries; clients reconcile authority state with monotonic generation and full-mask replacement; duplicate/stale messages are harmless while contradictory state fails closed; disconnect, room, spectator, stage-end, and transport teardown retire the lane. This is source-connected but unverified, so prior automated and initiator-role receipts remain historical evidence and the inverse role is still open.

The current source/test contract now also removes public direct SVC cutscene writers, requires the terminal END before stage teardown crosses into lobby state, and pins queue-only serialization plus prepare/send/commit ordering. It remains explicitly unbuilt and unverified; both authority-role ordinary-client smokes are required on the replacement source freeze.

Luna final-delta findings were integrated before the replacement freeze. The server no longer reconstructs cutscene identity after stage serialization: one immutable write plan owns both wire bytes and the authority snapshot. Same-room observers intentionally remain in the room destination scope while the frozen participant mask owns gameplay identity. Client script timing remains presentation prediction only; generation stays zero until authoritative START and reconciliation does not restart a predicted camera. Stage teardown now retains and retries one ordered END plus SVC_STAGE_END packet and commits local authority/lobby state only after successful queueing; duplicate partial-delivery retries are consumed idempotently. This is source truth only and has not yet passed the consolidated build/test/runtime batch.

T-ENGINE-004 remains partial. Historical B-1064 through B-1090 architecture and accepted listen-host, generated-audit, two-cycle Combat Simulator, and D-003 rollback baselines remain intact.

The current product freeze cc8791c1 built exact client D1C91583...; the complete suite passed 60,824 assertions in 1,152 cases and the native-source guard passed. Initiator authority passes 214/214 at results-20260814T020223Z.json. After a single coherent verifier correction and 402/13 focused B-1085 pass, invitee authority passes 218/218 at results-20260814T030245Z.json. The pair proves deterministic election/pre-connect latch, one in-client listen start, one non-authority idempotent match-server join, signed typed presence-v5 routes, no probe/relay-to-netStartClient handoff, protocol-v56 START/ACCEPT/END authority, receiver-local presentation, stable gameplay, fresh GUI-thread plus SDL gain/loss, post-loss owned fire/effects, clean exits, and zero leaks on the same product binary. The final product/test/tool fingerprint remained 2784d121... before and after. B-1082 through B-1090 are regression gates.

B-1064 reconnect is source-connected and statically verified; its ordinary-client runtime receipt is still pending. Protocol v57 scopes the in-memory cookie and frozen settings to the resolved endpoint, uses connect data only as a stable-slot hint, retains the preserved player/room through manifest and asynchronous stage load, keeps simultaneous timed absences in the immutable replay roster, and makes post-load CLC_STAGE_READY the server commit boundary. One targeted ordered packet announces the exact authoritative replicated-prop set, removes stale stage-load props before supported dynamic weapon/autogun reconstruction, restores attachment/projectile/object links plus every stable inventory, movement/stats, chr/bot, score, cutscene, and applicable co-op mission state, suppresses one-shot input/throw-effect replay, and terminates with SVC_RECONNECT_COMMIT. Initial prop IDs now cover the complete allocated raw pool and runtime IDs remain monotonic beyond the fixed fast-lookup window. Prepare/write/send failures roll back; malformed controls are terminal.

The accepted mask-corrected isolated client/updater build uses product-source fingerprint 3b6bcfe4... and client SHA-256 07E2D24F.... Focused B-1064 automation passes 335 assertions in 6 cases. The first full run exposed four stale structural guards that still inspected pre-refactor wrappers or a substring-collided helper; all four production boundaries were audited and their exact entry/helper contracts were corrected together without changing product source. Test binary 1A6246ED... passes the complete 61,241 assertions in 1,157 cases, and the native-source guard passes. One ordinary two-client timeout/reconnect smoke and a no-overlap fingerprint check remain before B-1064 runtime acceptance. Campaign/player-init, transition reset, broader rollback, strengthened listen-host lifecycle, and V-009 remain separate open T-ENGINE-004 work. B-1086/V-010 remains a separate white-door repro. Do not close T-ENGINE-004 from static/full evidence alone.

The rejected results-20260814T070008Z receipt now proves the B-1092 production policy boundary itself: the server consumed explicit timeout intent reason 5 over sender-local transport reason 0, preserved the complete reconnect snapshot and one room reservation, and the client retained its credential. It also exposed B-1093 in verification, not reconnect authority: smoke readiness still sampled hardcoded player 0 after the ordinary client authenticated as stable client 1. The next source-frozen unit replaces that assumption with the canonical receiver-local resolver, then reruns one consolidated build/test/smoke gate.

detail.from:
T-ENGINE-004 remains partial. Historical B-1064 through B-1090 architecture and accepted listen-host, generated-audit, two-cycle Combat Simulator, and D-003 rollback baselines remain intact.

The current product freeze cc8791c1 built exact client D1C91583...; the complete suite passed 60,824 assertions in 1,152 cases and the native-source guard passed. Initiator authority passes 214/214 at results-20260814T020223Z.json. After a single coherent verifier correction and 402/13 focused B-1085 pass, invitee authority passes 218/218 at results-20260814T030245Z.json. The pair proves deterministic election/pre-connect latch, one in-client listen start, one non-authority idempotent match-server join, signed typed presence-v5 routes, no probe/relay-to-netStartClient handoff, protocol-v56 START/ACCEPT/END authority, receiver-local presentation, stable gameplay, fresh GUI-thread plus SDL gain/loss, post-loss owned fire/effects, clean exits, and zero leaks on the same product binary. The final product/test/tool fingerprint remained 2784d121... before and after. B-1082 through B-1090 are regression gates.

B-1064 reconnect is source-connected and statically verified; its ordinary-client runtime receipt is still pending. Protocol v57 scopes the in-memory cookie and frozen settings to the resolved endpoint, uses connect data only as a stable-slot hint, retains the preserved player/room through manifest and asynchronous stage load, keeps simultaneous timed absences in the immutable replay roster, and makes post-load CLC_STAGE_READY the server commit boundary. One targeted ordered packet announces the exact authoritative replicated-prop set, removes stale stage-load props before supported dynamic weapon/autogun reconstruction, restores attachment/projectile/object links plus every stable inventory, movement/stats, chr/bot, score, cutscene, and applicable co-op mission state, suppresses one-shot input/throw-effect replay, and terminates with SVC_RECONNECT_COMMIT. Initial prop IDs now cover the complete allocated raw pool and runtime IDs remain monotonic beyond the fixed fast-lookup window. Prepare/write/send failures roll back; malformed controls are terminal.

The accepted mask-corrected isolated client/updater build uses product-source fingerprint 3b6bcfe4... and client SHA-256 07E2D24F.... Focused B-1064 automation passes 335 assertions in 6 cases. The first full run exposed four stale structural guards that still inspected pre-refactor wrappers or a substring-collided helper; all four production boundaries were audited and their exact entry/helper contracts were corrected together without changing product source. Test binary 1A6246ED... passes the complete 61,241 assertions in 1,157 cases, and the native-source guard passes. One ordinary two-client timeout/reconnect smoke and a no-overlap fingerprint check remain before B-1064 runtime acceptance. Campaign/player-init, transition reset, broader rollback, strengthened listen-host lifecycle, and V-009 remain separate open T-ENGINE-004 work. B-1086/V-010 remains a separate white-door repro. Do not close T-ENGINE-004 from static/full evidence alone.

The rejected results-20260814T070008Z receipt proves the B-1092 policy boundary: the server consumed explicit timeout intent reason 5 over sender-local transport reason 0, preserved the complete reconnect snapshot and room reservation, and the client retained its credential. B-1093 then removed a structurally invalid hardcoded player-0 readiness projection and passed its consolidated build, focused/full suite, and native-source guard. The next exact-client run proved that client really used runtime slot 0, so B-1093 was not its blocker.

The exact FA70FC97... receipt at results-20260814T071725Z is rejected at 36/93. The client authenticated, loaded/spawned Felicity, published CLC_STAGE_READY, and ticked, but stayed in the local TICKMODE_MPSWIRL until timeout and never invoked reconnect. B-1094 is the production root: playerEndCutscene guarded the entire shared helper by client role. Current source delegates to playerSetTickMode, which protects only real client CUTSCENE exits for the full match authority lifetime and permits the MP swirl to reach normal play. One consolidated frozen build/focused/full/native-source batch and one ordinary reconnect smoke remain required.

B-1094 verification reached a source-frozen client and explicit test build. The first valid focused run passed 524/524 across 10 cases and the native-source guard passed. The full suite rejected one test-only overbreadth: it searched the entire playerSetTickMode body for IsActive and therefore matched the legitimate server END condition. The static contract now isolates the client predicate and forbids IsActive only there. Product source is unchanged; test rebuild/full rerun and one ordinary reconnect smoke remain required.

T-ENGINE-004 remains partial. Historical B-1064 through B-1090 architecture and accepted listen-host, generated-audit, two-cycle Combat Simulator, and D-003 rollback baselines remain intact.

The current product freeze cc8791c1 built exact client D1C91583...; the complete suite passed 60,824 assertions in 1,152 cases and the native-source guard passed. Initiator authority passes 214/214 at results-20260814T020223Z.json. After a single coherent verifier correction and 402/13 focused B-1085 pass, invitee authority passes 218/218 at results-20260814T030245Z.json. The pair proves deterministic election/pre-connect latch, one in-client listen start, one non-authority idempotent match-server join, signed typed presence-v5 routes, no probe/relay-to-netStartClient handoff, protocol-v56 START/ACCEPT/END authority, receiver-local presentation, stable gameplay, fresh GUI-thread plus SDL gain/loss, post-loss owned fire/effects, clean exits, and zero leaks on the same product binary. The final product/test/tool fingerprint remained 2784d121... before and after. B-1082 through B-1090 are regression gates.

B-1064 reconnect is source-connected and statically verified; its ordinary-client runtime receipt is still pending. Protocol v57 scopes the in-memory cookie and frozen settings to the resolved endpoint, uses connect data only as a stable-slot hint, retains the preserved player/room through manifest and asynchronous stage load, keeps simultaneous timed absences in the immutable replay roster, and makes post-load CLC_STAGE_READY the server commit boundary. One targeted ordered packet announces the exact authoritative replicated-prop set, removes stale stage-load props before supported dynamic weapon/autogun reconstruction, restores attachment/projectile/object links plus every stable inventory, movement/stats, chr/bot, score, cutscene, and applicable co-op mission state, suppresses one-shot input/throw-effect replay, and terminates with SVC_RECONNECT_COMMIT. Initial prop IDs now cover the complete allocated raw pool and runtime IDs remain monotonic beyond the fixed fast-lookup window. Prepare/write/send failures roll back; malformed controls are terminal.

The accepted mask-corrected isolated client/updater build uses product-source fingerprint 3b6bcfe4... and client SHA-256 07E2D24F.... Focused B-1064 automation passes 335 assertions in 6 cases. The first full run exposed four stale structural guards that still inspected pre-refactor wrappers or a substring-collided helper; all four production boundaries were audited and their exact entry/helper contracts were corrected together without changing product source. Test binary 1A6246ED... passes the complete 61,241 assertions in 1,157 cases, and the native-source guard passes. One ordinary two-client timeout/reconnect smoke and a no-overlap fingerprint check remain before B-1064 runtime acceptance. Campaign/player-init, transition reset, broader rollback, strengthened listen-host lifecycle, and V-009 remain separate open T-ENGINE-004 work. B-1086/V-010 remains a separate white-door repro. Do not close T-ENGINE-004 from static/full evidence alone.

The rejected results-20260814T070008Z receipt proves the B-1092 policy boundary: the server consumed explicit timeout intent reason 5 over sender-local transport reason 0, preserved the complete reconnect snapshot and room reservation, and the client retained its credential. B-1093 then removed a structurally invalid hardcoded player-0 readiness projection and passed its consolidated build, focused/full suite, and native-source guard. The next exact-client run proved that client really used runtime slot 0, so B-1093 was not its blocker.

The exact FA70FC97... receipt at results-20260814T071725Z is rejected at 36/93. The client authenticated, loaded/spawned Felicity, published CLC_STAGE_READY, and ticked, but stayed in the local TICKMODE_MPSWIRL until timeout and never invoked reconnect. B-1094 is the production root: playerEndCutscene guarded the entire shared helper by client role. Current source delegates to playerSetTickMode, which protects only real client CUTSCENE exits for the full match authority lifetime and permits the MP swirl to reach normal play. One consolidated frozen build/focused/full/native-source batch and one ordinary reconnect smoke remain required.

B-1094 verification reached a source-frozen client and explicit test build. The first valid focused run passed 524/524 across 10 cases and the native-source guard passed. The full suite rejected one test-only overbreadth: it searched the entire playerSetTickMode body for IsActive and therefore matched the legitimate server END condition. The static contract now isolates the client predicate and forbids IsActive only there. Product source is unchanged; test rebuild/full rerun and one ordinary reconnect smoke remain required.

B-1094 automation is accepted on unchanged product and verification aggregates. The exact client build passes focused 527/10, complete 61,325/1,160, and the native-source guard. The one remaining gate for this reconnect unit is the ordinary two-client timeout/reconnect smoke with exact replay and resumed authority.

B-1095 is the current runtime blocker. A peer-dependent host deadline started before its externally gated client could exist: 83 seconds of host cold startup plus 72 seconds of client cold startup exceeded the 150-second boot-relative stage-live wait. The structural correction is a typed network_listen_ready production barrier before the host stage-live wait; timeout inflation or a fixed sleep is not accepted.

B-1095 source and automation are accepted. The pure condition requires active server networking plus a published ENet host, the runtime projects that exact state, and the reconnect host fixture starts its stage-live clock only after the listener barrier. One exact-client ordinary reconnect rerun remains.

detail.from:
T-ENGINE-004 remains partial. Historical c3746 and the accepted ordinary listen-host, generated-audit, two-cycle Combat Simulator, D-003 rollback, and current two-role authority-first friend-play baselines remain intact. Initiator authority passes 214/214 at results-20260814T020223Z.json and invitee authority passes 218/218 at results-20260814T030245Z.json on the same D1C91583... product binary; the final source/test/tool fingerprint remained 2784d121.... B-1082 through B-1090 are regression gates.

Protocol v57 reconnect is one endpoint-scoped, server-authoritative transaction. The preserved stable slot and cookie survive manifest and asynchronous stage replay; post-load CLC_STAGE_READY is the commit boundary. The targeted ordered snapshot announces and reconciles the exact replicated-prop set, then restores stable-player inventory, stats, movement, characters, scores, cutscene state, applicable cooperative state, and an explicit reconnect commit. Validation remains fail closed and one-shot gameplay commands are not replayed.

Accepted automation through B-1095 is retained: product 8f94b807... / client 33C8FDF8..., verification e94a10d4... / pd-tests DFCE2DFF..., focused 537 assertions in 11 cases, complete 61,337 assertions in 1,161 cases, and native-source guard pass. Earlier rejected runtime receipts remain diagnostic evidence only.

The retained results-20260814T082045Z.json receipt is rejected at 56/93 but proves the B-1095 listener barrier, initial ordinary gameplay, timeout intent and reservation preservation, endpoint-scoped reconnect authentication, manifest acceptance, stage replay, post-load READY, and room reclaim. B-1096 root is now source-confirmed: disconnect death creates a dropped CMP150 through the shared projectile initializer, which populated obj->projectile but omitted the required projectile->obj reverse link. The exact world writer correctly rejected that inconsistent authority graph, while the old compound boundary erased the substage and falsely selected DISCONNECT_FILES.

Current source fixes the shared ownership invariant rather than weakening validation. It also returns typed snapshot status plus client, prop, objective, attempted bytes, and capacity; atomically restores the packet prefix on every failure; logs the first owner; and gives authority-local stage/state write or send failures the retryable timeout close so a valid credential is not consumed as peer content corruption. This source unit is not yet verified.

Required next gates are one source-frozen isolated client/tests build, the focused reconnect contracts, the complete suite, native-source guard, and one ordinary two-client timeout/reconnect smoke proving exact world/inventory commit, resumed authoritative fire, clean exits, and unchanged source. Do not close T-ENGINE-004 from static or component evidence alone. Separate open T-ENGINE work remains ordinary Campaign/player-init, transition reset, broader rollback/lifecycle coverage, and the V-009 visual regression gate; B-1086/V-010 remains the separate white-door repro.

The exact world writer correctly rejected that inconsistent authority graph, while the old compound boundary erased the substage and falsely selected DISCONNECT_FILES.

Current B-1096 source fixes the shared ownership invariant rather than weakening validation. It returns typed snapshot status plus client, prop, objective, attempted bytes, and capacity; atomically restores the packet prefix on every failure; logs the first owner; and gives authority-local stage/state write or send failures the retryable timeout close so a valid credential is not consumed as peer content corruption.

Static/component evidence does not close it. T-ENGINE-004 remains partial. Accepted baselines retain ordinary listen-host, generated-audit, two-cycle Combat Simulator, D-003 rollback, and both authority-first friend-play roles. D-003 initiator authority is 214/214 and invitee authority is 218/218 on client D1C91583...; B-1082 through B-1090 remain regression gates.

The preserved stable slot and cookie survive manifest and asynchronous stage replay; post-load CLC_STAGE_READY is the commit boundary. One ordered targeted packet reconciles exact world state, inventories/stats/movement, characters, scores, cutscene/co-op state, and explicit SVC_RECONNECT_COMMIT. Validation remains fail closed.

The exact follow-up results-20260814T094551Z.json is retained but rejected at 55/93 with zero operational failures or leaks. Typed diagnosis names a live host Cyclone prop 4, parent 1, hidden 0 as attachment_pair. Terminal deletion is not this boundary.

B-1097/SP-61 is source-confirmed. modeldef.parts packs numparts modelnode pointers followed by numparts sorted s16 part numbers. modeldefCloneForChr remapped only the pointer vector into an undersized allocation while modelGetPart always bisects the omitted sidecar. chrEquipWeapon therefore set attachedtomodel before the corrupted right-hand lookup returned no node. This is a foundational per-character model-graph clone defect, not a serializer exception.

Next: clone the complete packed table transactionally, pin the lookup/layout contract, run one consolidated source-frozen build/focused/full/native-guard batch, then one replacement ordinary reconnect smoke requiring PREPARE, exact world/inventory commit, resumed authoritative fire, clean exits, no false file mismatch, and unchanged fingerprints.
